info.title: Sous
info.description:
Sous is a household recipe manager. Every response is JSON except images.

Errors are always {"error":{"code","message"}}; branch on code, which is stable. importRecipe
adds a top-level summary, a sentence to read aloud.

Identity: behind the Outpost gateway, the caller comes from its signed token. Otherwise
name yourself with the X-Sous-Person header (a username from GET /v1/people). Reads need
no person; writes from nobody get 401 who_are_you.

Concurrency: recipes carry a version, returned as the ETag. PATCH and DELETE need
If-Match with that version; a stale one gets 412 with the current recipe.

Lists page by opaque cursor: pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null.

url.description: the recipe page to read and save

summary.description: one sentence saying what happened, to read aloud

path.description: the recipe's page in the web UI, relative to Sous

url.description: the recipe's page as a full link, through the Outpost gateway; null on the direct route

duplicate.description: the link was already in Sous; nothing new was saved

restored.description: the copy already in Sous was in the trash and has been restored

missing.description: what the page lacked: title, ingredients, steps, times, yield or image

person_id.description: username of who made the change

deleted.description: the existing copy is in the trash

summary.description: one sentence to read aloud; only importRecipe sends it

code.description: stable code to branch on, such as who_are_you, not_found or stale

hash.description: set when the photo was stored in Sous
lower-case hex SHA-256 of the image bytes

page.description: the page's link, title and photo, when it was reached

summary.description: one sentence to read aloud; only importRecipe sends it

draft.description: the recipe as read; POST it to /v1/recipes to save

ingredients.description: draft.ingredients as the server would store them

images.description: photos found on the page, best first

duplicates.description: recipes already in Sous from the same link

source_url.description: the link the recipe is credited to

fetched_url.description: the URL actually fetched, when it differs (an archive copy, a redirect)

url.description: the recipe page to read; with text, only the link the recipe is credited to, never fetched

text.description: recipe text pasted by a person; split into ingredients and steps without fetching anything

title.description: with text: a title carried over from a page that had no recipe data

section.description: the heading this line sits under, or null

quantity_max.description: upper bound of a range such as '2 to 4'

unit.description: normalised unit such as tbsp, g or cup

item.description: the ingredient itself; the whole line when it can't be parsed

ok.description: whether the last JWKS fetch succeeded

fetched_at.description: time of the last successful fetch, UTC RFC 3339, or null if never

error.description: why the last fetch failed, or null

source.description: outpost when signed in through the Outpost gateway, which fixes who this is; device when chosen on this device

portal.description: with source outpost: the Outpost portal, where the person's account, sign-out and other apps are

name.description: display name; the username is derived from it

source_url.description: where the recipe came from, if anywhere

yield_text.description: the yield as written, e.g. 'Serves 4 to 6'

servings.description: the first number in yield_text; derived, read-only

time_text.description: original time wording when it doesn't parse into minutes

tags.description: tag names in order; the first is shown as the course

images.description: image hashes; the first is the cover

version.description: incremented on every change; send it back as If-Match or version

deleted_at.description: set when the recipe is in the trash

source_host.description: hostname of source_url without www.; derived, read-only

yield_text.description: the yield as written; servings are derived from it

tags.description: tag names in order; the first is shown as the course

images.description: hashes from image uploads; the first is the cover

ingredients.description: raw ingredient lines; '# Heading' starts a section

steps.description: raw step lines; '# Heading' starts a section

ingredients.description: replaces all ingredients; raw lines, '# Heading' starts a section

steps.description: replaces all steps; raw lines, '# Heading' starts a section

current.description: the recipe as it now stands; its version is the one to send next

jwks.description: gateway key cache health; null when not in gateway mode

section.description: the heading this step sits under, or null

cover.description: hash of the first image, or null

total_minutes.description: total, else prep plus cook when either is set, else null

total.description: number of matching items across all pages

next_cursor.description: pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

Person.name: X-Sous-Person
Person.description: username of the person making the request, when not behind the Outpost gateway

Via.name: X-Sous-Via
Via.description: ui for the web UI; anything else is recorded as api
